By saying he “doesn’t care too much for pussy,” Kodak is alluding to a meaning opposite 2Pac’s words in his second line; 2Pac enjoyed sex as much as revenge, but Kodak’s motivation for killing will instead be just because he admits it’s his nature, so he doesn’t need to compare it to any kind of joy.
